notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hey! I updated the game. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*] Added 31 achievements.
[*] Added 11 languages.
[*] Changed the render mode, the game will look smoother.
[*] Added a button ("F") for the fullscreen toggle.
[*] Fixed some glitches and sounds.
[/list]

Since the game doesn't have much text in it, I've used Google Translate for these languages: French, Italian, German, Russian. If you think you can do a better translation for any of these languages and want to help me, please contact me.


[b]Translation Credits:[/b]

Portuguese - Brazil:  https://twitter.com/CharmanderCrazy


Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese: Ye from AkabaStudio	

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AkabaStudio

(You should play LoveChoice 拣爱 by Ye)


[b]THANK YOU!
[/b]

Please let me know if you find any issues.
